CRIT-ORI-CLEAN.drill_hint: If the paper stops looking like any reference state, unfold to the last matching state and redo that fold.
CRIT-ORI-CLEAN.why_it_matters: The expert goes from R0 to R4 along the demonstrated state sequence (CLM-06).

CRIT-ORI-COMPLETE.drill_hint: Pause at each reference state and compare your paper to its keyframe before folding on.
CRIT-ORI-COMPLETE.why_it_matters: The demonstration passes through 5 distinct states (CLM-01-CLM-05).

CRIT-ORI-FINAL.drill_hint: Compare your final paper with the target keyframe property by property.
CRIT-ORI-FINAL.why_it_matters: The demonstration ends in R4 (kite form): arrowhead shape; taller than wide; taller-than-wide; yellow paper visible (CLM-05).

CRIT-ORI-KEYSTEP.drill_hint: Practise the fold from R0 to R1 slowly, matching the reference keyframe.
CRIT-ORI-KEYSTEP.why_it_matters: R1 (book-folded rectangle) is the state the expert spends longest reaching (38 s of folding from R0) (CLM-02).

CRIT-ORI-ORDER.drill_hint: Fold along with the reference keyframes one state at a time and check each state before moving on.
CRIT-ORI-ORDER.why_it_matters: The expert's video establishes the path R0 flat square -> R1 book-folded rectangle -> R2 diagonal-folded triangle -> R3 square base -> R4 kite form (CLM-06).
